prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person wearing a black jacket with white stripes on the sleeves, black pants, white sneakers, and a black cap"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08", "P09"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P02","P03","P04","P05","P06","P07","P08","P09"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"All individuals in the image tiles are wearing black jackets, black pants, white sneakers, and black caps. The white stripes on the sleeves are visible on the jackets of all persons in at least one of the provided crops, confirming the full appearance match for all labeled tiles."}

parsed.reason: All individuals in the image tiles are wearing black jackets, black pants, white sneakers, and black caps. The white stripes on the sleeves are visible on the jackets of all persons in at least one of the provided crops, confirming the full appearance match for all labeled tiles.
